script_text: Taurus, brace yourself—your ruling planet Venus is stirring powerful energies this week that could redefine your love and financial paths in profound ways. As the week begins, Venus in your 11th House forms a harmonious sextile with Uranus in your 1st House on Monday, sparking unexpected social opportunities and innovative ideas. Tuesday sees Mercury in your 10th House square Saturn, bringing career tensions and potential delays—avoid major decisions and double-check communications. Wednesday is smoother with a Moon trine in your 4th House, favoring home comforts and emotional stability. Mid-week, the Sun enters Aries on Thursday, illuminating your 12th House and urging introspection before action—pay attention to dreams and intuition. By Friday, Mars in your 8th House opposes Pluto, intensifying shared resources and power dynamics—watch for power struggles in joint finances. The weekend calms with a Venus-Jupiter trine in your 7th House, enhancing romantic connections and financial gains through partnerships. Thursday is your power day because the Sun's ingress into your 12th House deepens intuition for hidden opportunities. Tuesday is challenging due to Mercury square Saturn in your 10th House, risking career misunderstandings and frustration. Focus on harmonizing your Earth element by grounding yourself in nature to navigate the week's shifts effectively. Follow for daily updates.
